Dock height
Adjust background space above and below icons without resizing them. Default: 18 dp.
Left and right padding
Adjust the space between the outer icons and the glass edges. 0 dp keeps the default spacing. Available width may limit the adjustment.
The current home screen does not support this adjustment. Reset Dock geometry to restore default spacing.
Vertical position
Positive moves down; negative moves up, within available space. Default: 0 dp.
Custom corner radius
Used only with Custom radius. The background bounds limit the visible radius. Default: 24 dp.
Reset Dock geometry
Restore the default corners, height, left and right padding, and vertical position.
